title: Yellow Punk Rocker Girl
description: A stylized female character with voluminous bright yellow hair styled in a high messy updo with a black comb stuck in it. She wears a black and yellow punk outfit with a cropped jacket labeled 'VITA', fingerless gloves, fishnet accents, and heavy black boots, striking a confident pose pointing to the right.
prompt: A sassy female punk rocker character with massive bright yellow messy updo hair and a black comb in it, wearing a black and yellow cropped jacket with 'VITA' text, black shorts with yellow straps, fishnet gloves, and heavy black boots with yellow laces. She stands in a dynamic pose pointing to the right with one hand on her hip, wearing long earrings and a choker, against a solid gray background, in a bold vibrant cartoon style with clean lines and slight sparkle effects.
